description: This file contains unit tests for the EnterpriseRouteChecks class related to route access control logic within an enterprise authorization module. It tests behavior such as raising HTTP exceptions when management or LLM API routes are disabled and ensures correct route handling under various scenarios.

classes.name: TestEnterpriseRouteChecks
classes.description: Unit test class for EnterpriseRouteChecks, using pytest and mocking to verify route access logic under different configurations.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_management_disabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_management_disabled )
methods.description: Verifies that should_call_route raises an HTTP 403 exception when management routes are disabled and the route is a management route.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_llm_api_disabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Verifies that should_call_route raises an HTTP 403 exception when LLM API routes are disabled and the route is an LLM API route.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_both_disabled_management_takes_priority( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Checks that the management route disablement takes precedence over LLM API disablement when both are disabled.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_enabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Tests that no exception is raised when routes are enabled (either management or LLM API routes).

methods.name: test_should_call_route_management_disabled_llm_enabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Ensures that routes are accessible when only management routes are disabled but LLM API routes are enabled.

methods.name: test_should_call_route_llm_disabled_management_enabled( self, mock_is_management_route, mock_is_llm_api_route, mock_is_management_disabled, mock_is_llm_api_disabled, )
methods.description: Ensures that routes are accessible when only LLM API routes are disabled but management routes are enabled.
